about.title: About Us
about.heading: Welcome to SMOG&Co!
about.content: SMOG, Speaking with Support of Signs, is a service from the socio-cultural organization Gezin en Handicap. They are the point of contact for parents of a child with a disability.
about.mission1Rest: to everyone who can benefit from it.
about.mission1Description1: To this end, we organize courses for individuals and professionals, and we issue official SMOG certificates. These allow professionals to teach SMOG to people with communication disabilities and their environment.
about.mission1Description2: We teach the gestures for free in our videos and share blog articles.
about.mission1Description3: We issue quality labels to organizations that work with SMOG on a daily basis.
about.mission1Description4: Through these actions, we help ensure that anyone with a communication limitation and their environment can learn and use SMOG to communicate.
about.mission2Bold: 2. We are the point of contact for questions about SMOG
about.mission2Rest: from parents, friends, and caregivers of people with communication challenges, as well as from professionals, participants, and students.
about.description: This is a simple app to learn and practice sign language gestures. It includes a collection of gestures, their meanings, and related gestures.
